description: Create a questionnaire for a client in a project (platform owner only). Give `markdown` (headings = sections, numbered lines = questions, indented "- " lines under a question = its options, "- [ ]" = multiple choice, trailing * = required) or a `questions` list. Returns the form with `url`: send that link to the client. `issue` (optional) is the task that receives the answers as a comment.

issue.description: issue the answers are added to as a comment, e.g. "WEB-12" (optional)

markdown.description: the questions as Markdown: headings are sections, list items are questions

questions.description: the questions as a list (instead of markdown)

id.description: keep the id of an existing question when editing so answers stay attached

type.description: section = heading; choice = pick one of `options`; multi = pick several

thanks.description: message shown after the client sends the answers

title.description: questionnaire title, e.g. "Brief for the website"

name: create_form
